effects: Pulls `amount` sUSDe (the vault's collateral) from the signer into the vault with safeTransferFrom. This spends the signer's sUSDe allowance to the vault.
Mints vault shares (an ERC-20 of the vault) to `onBehalfOf`. The number of shares is computed from the vault's active stake and active shares.
Reverts if the deposit whitelist is on and the signer is not whitelisted, or if the deposit limit would be exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 sUSDe for the beneficiary, with the vault, the sUSDe amount and the beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown; it is computed from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)`; VaultTokenized.deposit emits `Transfer(address(0), onBehalfOf, mintedShares)`. The descriptor has fields only for amount and onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: No calldata holds the share count. Optionally say in the intent that vault shares go to the beneficiary, e.g. 'Deposit {amount} and mint vault shares to {onBehalfOf}'.

effects: Burns the signer's vault shares. The count is previewWithdraw(amount), which rounds up, and the call reverts if the signer holds fewer.
Queues `amount` sUSDe as withdrawal shares for the next epoch, credited to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it after the epoch ends.
No tokens move now. The queued amount can still be slashed until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 sUSDe for the claim owner, with the vault, the sUSDe amount and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the vault shares burned from the signer are not shown; they are derived from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`; _withdraw: `_activeSharesOf[msg.sender].push(..., activeSharesOf(msg.sender) - burnedShares)`. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.claimer`.
findings.fix: None in calldata. The intent could mention that vault shares are burned and the claim opens after the epoch ends.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's vault shares. Reverts if the signer holds fewer.
Queues the sUSDe value of those shares (previewRedeem, from storage) as a withdrawal for the next epoch, credited to `claimer`.
No tokens move now. The claim opens after the epoch ends and can be slashed until then.
formats.shown: Queue 0.987654321123456789 vault shares (named after the vault token) for the claim owner, with the vault, the shares and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the sUSDe amount queued for the claimer is not shown; it is computed from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())`. No field holds it.

findings.title: redeem: the interpolated intent 'Queue {shares} for {claimer}' leaves out the word withdrawal and can read as a swap.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem interpolatedIntent: "Queue {shares} for {claimer}"; case 5 renders 'Queue 0.987654321123456789 Gauntlet Restaked sUSDe for 0x3333…'.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed. Reverts if the epoch has not ended or was already claimed.
Sends sUSDe from the vault to `recipient`. The amount is the signer's share of that epoch's withdrawals (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)).
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient, with the vault, the epoch and the recipient as fields; neither the asset nor the amount is named.

findings.title: claim: the screen never says sUSDe is sent to the recipient; only the epoch number appears.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. descriptor intent "Claim withdrawal", interpolatedIntent "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}" (case 3: 'Claim epoch 42 to 0x2222…').
findings.fix: Name the asset: intent 'Claim sUSDe withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim sUSDe from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the sUSDe amount paid out is read from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for each listed epoch as claimed. Reverts if any epoch has not ended or was already claimed.
Sends the summed sUSDe of all listed epochs from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the listed epochs to the recipient, with the vault, one 'Epoch' field per epoch and the recipient as fields; neither the asset nor the amount is named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never says sUSDe is sent to the recipient; only epoch numbers appear.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. descriptor intent "Claim withdrawals", interpolatedIntent "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}" (case 4: 'Claim epochs 42 and 44 and 128 to 0x2222…').
findings.fix: Use intent 'Claim sUSDe withdrawals' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim sUSDe from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total sUSDe paid out is the sum of storage values and cannot be shown.
